services.name: ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry
services.tagline: The service registry of the ELIXIR On-Cloud network
services.blurb: The ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment of the GA4GH Service Registry, with a web dashboard for browsing and monitoring registered services across environments.
services.description: The ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry is a running deployment of the Cloud Registry product, the GA4GH Service Registry API implementation for ELIXIR On-Cloud. It gives the network one place to see which services exist, who runs them, in which environment and at which version. The web dashboard is built for managing and monitoring registered services across all environments.
audience: Anyone looking for services in the ELIXIR On-Cloud network
features: Services overview listing each registered service with its ID, name, artifact, organization, environment and version
Service Types view
Service Info view
Light and dark theme toggle

services.name: ELIXIR On-Cloud Demonstrator
services.tagline: Try federated task execution in the browser
services.blurb: A live demonstrator of GA4GH TES-based task execution across the ELIXIR On-Cloud network, built on the TES Dashboard.
services.description: The Demonstrator is a public deployment of the TES Dashboard. It shows the ELIXIR On-Cloud compute stack end to end: submit tasks and workflows, follow them as they run on the TES network, and inspect the health of the gateway and the federated nodes.
audience: Node operators and developers who want to see the stack in action
features: Submit and track tasks across the federation
Network map of TES instances
Service health of the gateway and federated nodes

services.name: proTES Gateway
services.tagline: One entry point to the ELIXIR On-Cloud TES network
services.blurb: The central proTES deployment that receives GA4GH TES requests, applies middleware and forwards each task to a suitable node of the TES network.
services.description: The proTES Gateway is the ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment of proTES. Clients talk to a single GA4GH TES endpoint; the gateway applies the configured middleware (for example access control and task distribution) and relays each task to one of the independently operated TES nodes in the network.
audience: Workflow engines and clients submitting TES tasks
features: Single GA4GH TES endpoint for the whole network
Middleware-based task distribution across nodes
Asynchronous tracking of forwarded tasks

services.name: TES Network
services.tagline: Federated GA4GH TES compute across ELIXIR Nodes
services.blurb: Independently operated GA4GH TES endpoints at ELIXIR Nodes, reachable together through the proTES Gateway.
services.description: The TES network is the compute layer of ELIXIR On-Cloud. Each participating ELIXIR Node runs its own GA4GH TES endpoint, for example TESK on Kubernetes or Funnel on HPC, and joins the federation behind the proTES Gateway. Nodes can be onboarded by following the administrator guide in the Documentation Hub.
audience: Researchers running containerized tasks close to their data
ELIXIR Nodes that want to contribute compute
features: Standard GA4GH TES API at every node
Kubernetes (TESK, Poiesis) and HPC (Funnel) backends
Federated access through the proTES Gateway

services.name: WESkit @ BIH
services.tagline: GA4GH WES for Snakemake and Nextflow workflows
services.blurb: A WESkit deployment at the Berlin Institute of Health at Charité (BIH) that runs Snakemake and Nextflow workflows through the GA4GH WES API.
services.description: WESkit is a GA4GH Workflow Execution Service (WES) implementation for Snakemake and Nextflow. The ELIXIR On-Cloud deployment is operated at the Berlin Institute of Health at Charité (BIH) and gives the network a WES endpoint for whole workflows, complementing task-level execution on the TES network.
audience: Researchers running Snakemake or Nextflow workflows
features: Implements the GA4GH WES API
Runs Snakemake and Nextflow workflows
Operated by an ELIXIR Germany partner

services.name: Conquest
services.tagline: Nextflow, WDL and Snakemake runs through GA4GH WES
services.blurb: A public Conquest deployment, the second WES backend for running Nextflow, WDL and Snakemake workflows from the TES Dashboard.
services.description: Conquest is implemented but not yet deployed for ELIXIR On-Cloud. The first deployment will run tasks on Conquest's own internal TES/Kubernetes backend; it will later submit tasks to the proTES Gateway so that they run on the TES network.
audience: Researchers running Nextflow, WDL or Snakemake workflows
features: GA4GH WES API with Nextflow, WDL and Snakemake engines
Listed in the ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry once deployed

services.name: Pubgrade
services.blurb: The central Pubgrade instance: developers register repositories, Pubgrade builds and publishes images, and subscribed deployments are notified of updates.
services.description: The central Pubgrade (broadcasting) service is not yet deployed. Once running, it will build and publish images for registered repositories and notify subscribed deployments through Pubgrade-Sidecar, optionally linked to the ELIXIR On-Cloud Registry.
audience: Node operators who want deployments to update themselves
features: Register repositories and publish builds
Notify subscribed deployments on new builds
